description: Check EU compliance status for a Korean statute or provision. Detects references to EU directives/regulations and reports alignment status. Note: South Korea does not have an EU GDPR adequacy decision. Returns compliance status: compliant, partial, unclear, or not_applicable.

document_id.description: Korean statute identifier (e.g., "act-16930") or title (e.g., "개인정보 보호법")

eu_document_id.description: Optional: check compliance with a specific EU document (e.g., "regulation:2016/679")

name: validate_eu_compliance
